8384408: AArch64: Replace DCPS1 with UDF

For deoptimization purposes, post-call NOP sequences are concurrently
patched to DCPS1 instruction (NativeDeoptInstruction::insert). DCPS1
is not on the CMODX list. Replace DCPS1 with UDF, for which there is
no issue with concurrent patching.

Also, remove unused NativeIllegalInstruction and replace DCPS1 with
UDF for MacroAssembler::stop.

See also:
 B2.2.5 Concurrent modification and execution of instructions (CMODX)
 section of Arm Architecture Reference Manual for A-profile
 architecture Version M.b.
